record.context_brief: Transitive C3 x C3 center in degree 9
record.original_question: Let H = C_3 x C_3 be the transitive subgroup of S_9 described in the paper. Is the corresponding field Z_H(F,9) rational, stably rational, or retract rational over F?

evidence.quote: Problem 5.2. Determine if Z_H(F, 9) is rational, stably rational, or retract rational, where H = C_3 x C_3 subset S_9 is transitive.

artifact.status_search_result: Web searches for the rationality, stable rationality, and retract rationality of the fixed field of the transitive $C_3\times C_3 \subset S_9$ acting by its regular representation did not return a definitive published resolution. Standard results of Fischer/Lenstra address Noether's problem for abelian groups under hypotheses on roots of unity in $F$, but a conclusive answer to all three rationality questions over an arbitrary field $F$ for this specific transitive embedding was not located in the searches.

status_evidence.title: Retract rationality and Noether's problem
status_evidence.snippet: Saltman/Kang work on retract rationality of invariant fields; general criteria but no specific resolution for transitive C_3 x C_3 in S_9.
status_evidence.claim: Retract rationality framework relevant to the problem is established but the specific case is not settled here.

status_evidence.title: Noether's problem for transitive permutation groups of degree 6
status_evidence.snippet: Treats degree 6 transitive groups; degree 9 case is not covered.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous degree-9 transitive case for C_3 x C_3 is not addressed in this reference.
